blocks.text: Personalized Treatment Red Road Recovery creates individualized treatment plans to address the specific needs of each client using the bio-psycho-social model. They integrate evidence-based therapies like talk therapy, narrative therapy, and creative therapies with the 12-Step philosophy. Their comprehensive approach includes 30, 60, and 90-day residential treatment options, as well as outpatient treatment, virtual care, family counseling, and aftercare services. Each program emphasizes the overall health of the client through nutritional meals, fitness and exercise, massage, relaxation therapy, yoga, and more.

blocks.text: Set in an idyllic location, Red Road Recovery provides a warm, caring place to completely focus on your path to recovery. It’s combination of 12-step programming and Indigenous Culture really emphasize the spiritual journey undertaken to combat addiction. It’s amazing counsellors and staff work with you in both a group setting and on an individual basis showing how much they care about your personal recovery. The level of caring doesn’t end the moment you walk out the door as they make the effort to keep in touch with you along your path as you go forward in this new chapter of your life.
I can’t express the profound effect Scotty, Chalen and the rest of the Red Road team has had on my life and on the lives of my loved ones. For that I will be forever grateful.
Even if you are unsure or afraid right now, a simple phone call could change your life forever. All you have to do is reach out.

I was in a place and time of no return rock bottom some would say with the help of red road I found the root of my addiction they help me understand that I wasn’t alone with the 12 steps and their guidance I have become a better father better brother and a better son their system works cause I’m 7 months sober

Scott and his team really helped me to break through my denial and made it easier to become willing to change for the better. They provided a safe place to go much deeper into myself and see the reasons that I was using drugs in the first place. I am very grateful to everyone at Red Road Recovery and look forward to giving back to others.

Red Road Recovery was the stepping stone to start my healing process after an extremely hard time in my life. Scotty and Chalen helped me to discover my journey in recovery, and I am incredibly grateful for this place and these people with all they have done to help me find myself again.
If you are struggling with mental health and addiction and looking for help, please consider Red Road Recovery. This place truly saved my life!

centre.about_html:
Welcome to Red Road Recovery – a premier addiction treatment center located in Sorrento, British Columbia, Canada. At Red Road Recovery, we are dedicated to providing comprehensive and compassionate care to individuals struggling with addiction and co-occurring disorders.

Our approach to treatment is unique, as we blend evidence-based therapy with traditional indigenous healing practices. We believe that healing must address the whole person – mind, body, and spirit – and strive to create an environment that nurtures all aspects of our clients’ well-being.

Our team of experienced professionals is committed to helping our clients achieve lasting recovery and reclaim their lives. Through a combination of individualized treatment plans, group therapy, and aftercare support, we equip our clients with the tools they need to build a strong foundation for their future.

At Red Road Recovery, we understand that each person’s journey to recovery is different, and we are here to support and guide you every step of the way. We invite you to learn more about our holistic approach to addiction treatment and join us on the path to healing.

Red Road Recovery - Center Overview

Red Road Recovery provides a serene and secure environment for those seeking to overcome drug and alcohol addiction and co-occurring disorders. With a focus on holistic healing, they blend conventional treatment techniques with indigenous healing practices to promote the restoration of the mind, body, and spirit. Collaborating with the local indigenous people, Red Road incorporates medicine wheel teachings and sweat lodge ceremonies to enhance the therapeutic benefits of nature.

Personalized Treatment Red Road Recovery creates individualized treatment plans to address the specific needs of each client using the bio-psycho-social model. They integrate evidence-based therapies like talk therapy, narrative therapy, and creative therapies with the 12-Step philosophy. Their comprehensive approach includes 30, 60, and 90-day residential treatment options, as well as outpatient treatment, virtual care, family counseling, and aftercare services. Each program emphasizes the overall health of the client through nutritional meals, fitness and exercise, massage, relaxation therapy, yoga, and more.

Idyllic Location Nestled on a hillside overlooking Shuswap lake and the surrounding mountains, Red Road Recovery’s facility offers a breathtaking location for healing and reflection. Private rooms with scenic views, ensuite bathrooms, a spacious outdoor deck area, and large common areas provide luxurious amenities to clients. Red Road Recovery’s holistic program, combined with the stunning setting, makes it an ideal choice for those seeking to treat addiction and co-occurring disorders simultaneously.

Frequently Asked Questions About Red Road Recovery

What is Red Road Recovery?

Red Road Recovery is a premier addiction treatment center located in Sorrento, British Columbia, Canada. We offer a unique approach to treatment that blends evidence-based therapy with traditional indigenous healing practices.

What types of addiction do you treat?

We treat a variety of addictions, including alcohol, drugs, gambling, and more.

What is your treatment approach?

Our treatment approach is holistic and focuses on treating the whole person – mind, body, and spirit. We blend evidence-based therapy with traditional indigenous healing practices to create a comprehensive treatment plan that addresses each individual’s unique needs.

Do you offer aftercare support?

Yes, we offer aftercare support to all of our clients to help them maintain their recovery after leaving our facility.

What qualifications do your staff members have?

Our staff members are highly qualified and experienced professionals in the addiction treatment field. We have licensed therapists, counselors, and medical professionals on staff to ensure the highest quality of care.

Do you accept insurance?

We accept most major insurance plans, and our admissions team can help you determine your coverage.

What is the length of your treatment programs?

The length of our treatment programs varies depending on each individual’s needs. We offer both short-term and long-term programs to accommodate a range of recovery journeys.

Is Red Road Recovery a residential facility?

Yes, we offer residential treatment programs in a safe and supportive environment where our clients can focus on their recovery without distractions from the outside world.

Welcome to Red Road Recovery – a premier addiction treatment center located in Sorrento, British Columbia, Canada. At Red Road Recovery, we are dedicated to providing comprehensive and compassionate care to individuals struggling with addiction and co-occurring disorders.

Our approach to treatment is unique, as we blend evidence-based therapy with traditional indigenous healing practices. We believe that healing must address the whole person – mind, body, and spirit – and strive to create an environment that nurtures all aspects of our clients’ well-being.

Our team of experienced professionals is committed to helping our clients achieve lasting recovery and reclaim their lives. Through a combination of individualized treatment plans, group therapy, and aftercare support, we equip our clients with the tools they need to build a strong foundation for their future.

At Red Road Recovery, we understand that each person’s journey to recovery is different, and we are here to support and guide you every step of the way. We invite you to learn more about our holistic approach to addiction treatment and join us on the path to healing.

Red Road Recovery - Center Overview

Red Road Recovery provides a serene and secure environment for those seeking to overcome drug and alcohol addiction and co-occurring disorders. With a focus on holistic healing, they blend conventional treatment techniques with indigenous healing practices to promote the restoration of the mind, body, and spirit. Collaborating with the local indigenous people, Red Road incorporates medicine wheel teachings and sweat lodge ceremonies to enhance the therapeutic benefits of nature.

Personalized Treatment Red Road Recovery creates individualized treatment plans to address the specific needs of each client using the bio-psycho-social model. They integrate evidence-based therapies like talk therapy, narrative therapy, and creative therapies with the 12-Step philosophy. Their comprehensive approach includes 30, 60, and 90-day residential treatment options, as well as outpatient treatment, virtual care, family counseling, and aftercare services. Each program emphasizes the overall health of the client through nutritional meals, fitness and exercise, massage, relaxation therapy, yoga, and more.

Idyllic Location Nestled on a hillside overlooking Shuswap lake and the surrounding mountains, Red Road Recovery’s facility offers a breathtaking location for healing and reflection. Private rooms with scenic views, ensuite bathrooms, a spacious outdoor deck area, and large common areas provide luxurious amenities to clients. Red Road Recovery’s holistic program, combined with the stunning setting, makes it an ideal choice for those seeking to treat addiction and co-occurring disorders simultaneously.

Frequently Asked Questions About Red Road Recovery

What is Red Road Recovery?

Red Road Recovery is a premier addiction treatment center located in Sorrento, British Columbia, Canada. We offer a unique approach to treatment that blends evidence-based therapy with traditional indigenous healing practices.

What types of addiction do you treat?

We treat a variety of addictions, including alcohol, drugs, gambling, and more.

What is your treatment approach?

Our treatment approach is holistic and focuses on treating the whole person – mind, body, and spirit. We blend evidence-based therapy with traditional indigenous healing practices to create a comprehensive treatment plan that addresses each individual’s unique needs.

Do you offer aftercare support?

Yes, we offer aftercare support to all of our clients to help them maintain their recovery after leaving our facility.

What qualifications do your staff members have?

Our staff members are highly qualified and experienced professionals in the addiction treatment field. We have licensed therapists, counselors, and medical professionals on staff to ensure the highest quality of care.

Do you accept insurance?

We accept most major insurance plans, and our admissions team can help you determine your coverage.

What is the length of your treatment programs?

The length of our treatment programs varies depending on each individual’s needs. We offer both short-term and long-term programs to accommodate a range of recovery journeys.

Is Red Road Recovery a residential facility?

Yes, we offer residential treatment programs in a safe and supportive environment where our clients can focus on their recovery without distractions from the outside world.
